diagnoses: Invited to diabetic eye screening, which checks the back of the eyes for damage from diabetes (diabetic retinopathy)
dates: The eye drops blur vision for 4 to 6 hours
actions: Do not drive until your vision is back to normal
Bring sunglasses if you have them
Bring your glasses or contact lenses and a list of your medicines
negatives: This screening does not diagnose other eye problems
It does not replace the regular eye test at an optician
